tasks.label: Console: Playwright browser (chromium)
tasks.command: corepack yarn workspace dfe-core-ui exec playwright install chromium

tasks.label: Engine: local ClickHouse (docker)
tasks.command: cd "${input:dfeEngineDir}" && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yaml up -d --wait clickhouse

tasks.label: Console: types, lint, unit tests
tasks.command: corepack yarn workspace dfe-core-ui check-types && corepack yarn workspace dfe-core-ui lint && corepack yarn workspace dfe-core-ui test

inputs.description: dfe-engine checkout, relative to this repo or absolute
